entries.title: v2.3.0
entries.note: What's Changed ✨ Added Piccolo Local Decision Models Add Piccolo 4B, 9B, and 27B as local decision models for tool review and context compaction, with BF16 and Q8_0 recommendations, runtime installation and updates, and Hugging Face or ModelScope downloads. Review and compaction remain opt-in; the local runtime serves one model at a time ( #8463 , #8573 ) QwenPaw Community Browse, sort, and comment on QwenPaw Community posts from the Console, draft resource-linked issue reports with model assistance, and open the community editor. Connect an account to sync selected message categories to the Inbox and desktop notifications ( #7903 ) Console & Desktop Add the optional OpenUI plugin to display interactive forms and components within replies, preserve their state during streaming, and submit actions to the originating conversation ( #8239 , #8248 ) Add an unread-only filter to Inbox pus

entries.title: v2.2.2
entries.note: What's Changed ✨ Added Console & Workspaces Add six theme palettes and custom colors and corner radii, with live preview and saved preferences ( #7741 ) Add an authenticated, multi-tab terminal inside Chat, with a working directory for each conversation ( #7861 ) Allow Console font size to be adjusted from 12 to 20 pixels across chat and settings ( #8005 ) Save multi-folder workspaces as an Agent’s default for future tasks ( #7789 ) Show files delivered by the Agent directly below its reply for easier preview and download ( #7750 ) QwenPaw-Flash Recommend QwenPaw-Flash 9B, 27B, and 35B-A3B locally: update the 9B recommendation and add 27B and 35B-A3B options ( #8155 ) PawPort Add PawPort to import supported conversations, memory, Skills, plugins, MCP settings, projects, and scheduled tasks from Codex and Qoder, with compatibility checks and selective retries ( #6960 ) QwenPaw Creator
